title: Flat Courtesy on Late-Posted Refunds to Ridgeline Consumer Credit Accounts
content:
A return credit posted to a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account for refunds from Ridgeline Special Order Services carries a flat courtesy that depends on how many calendar days have passed from the latest refund date to today — the latest special order refund issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name.

| Calendar days from the latest refund date to today | Flat courtesy |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 15.00 |
| 14 to 29 | 7.50 |
| fewer than 14 | nothing |

**How it is applied.** The flat courtesy is added to the interest part of the late-posting allowance once that interest part has been rounded to the nearest cent; the sum is the late-posting allowance as it then stands.

## Questions answered

**The latest refund was issued 13 days ago. Is there a flat courtesy?** No; fewer than 14 days have passed.

**And at 14 days, and at 29?** 7.50 in both cases.

**At exactly 30 days?** 15.00, as at any count of 30 or more.

**Hypothetical:** an interest part of 4.93 and 31 days since the latest refund give 4.93 plus 15.00, that is 19.93.
